newsitem.title: UK: UK meals/feeds track Chicago, trade quiet.
newsitem.headline: UK meals/feeds track Chicago, trade quiet.

text.p: UK meals and feeds prices continued to follow Chicago on Thursday, but traders reported little interest.
"Chicago is controlling the market, people say they are ignoring it, but it keeps going up against them," said one trader.
In general terms players said the market is suffering from BSE blues which has resulted in a lack of confidence everywhere.
High protein soymeal prices fell by one to two sterling a tonne in line with the lower Chicago market on Wednesday.
However, they are expected to be steady again on Friday if the U.S. market holds its opening gains on Thursday.
